newsitem.title: DENMARK: TELE DANMARK BUYS 20.8 PCT SHARE IN CESKE.
newsitem.headline: TELE DANMARK BUYS 20.8 PCT SHARE IN CESKE.

text.p: Danish telecommunications group Tele Danmark said on Tuesday it bought a 20.8 percent shareholding in the Czech Republic's Ceske Radiokomunikace telecommunication firm.

"The investment reflects Tele Danmark's ongoing interest in participating in the development of the telecommunications sector in the Czech Republic and its conviction that Ceske Radiokomunikace (CRK) can play a central role in the process," Tele Danmark said in a statement.

CRK, founded in 1994 as one of the first privatisation projects in the Czech Republic, is the country's leading operator in the transmission and distribution of television and radio, satellite services and fixed and mobile telephony.
Tele Danmark said CRK also owned 51 percent of Radiomobil, one of the Czech Republic's two mobile telephone operators.
The estimated price of the share purchase was approximately 385 million crowns at present market rates, it said.
